premises: Alumina (Al2O3) is chemically inert and structurally stable at high temperatures, enabling it to act as a diffusion barrier.
An ultrathin Al2O3 interlayer can be deposited conformally on zirconium alloy and remain adherent under subsequent Cr coating and service conditions.
The Al2O3 interlayer will effectively inhibit Cr–Zr interdiffusion at elevated temperatures.
Inhibiting Cr–Zr interdiffusion will prevent premature failure of the Cr coating and maintain its oxidation protection in both subcritical water and high-temperature steam.
